rulings.evidence: REUSE of a live board id at 6 of 7 stores, cheapest 0.1038 at Walmart; only the vocabulary row was missing. Deliberately NOT fresh-cranberries (the 2026-08-27 shelf ruling): a sweetened canned sauce carries 40 g carbs per 100 g against raw fruit's 12.

Chili flakes and red pepper flakes are one jar under two shelf names; the same-form vocabulary row exists and the 2026-08-26 'red chili flakes' ruling went here. Board found nothing, so the term is enqueued.

rulings.raw: Kosher salt and ground pepper, to taste
rulings.evidence: One line carrying two pantry seasonings; costed as salt (7 of 7) with the black pepper pantry-static, per the 'Salt/Pepper' and 'Salt and pepper' precedents. The three DIFFERENT FORM bell-pepper rows are a wording artefact of the word 'pepper'.
The line names chicken first and turkey as the alternative; chicken-breast is live at 7 of 7, cheapest 1.99 at Hy-Vee. Refused the turkey-breast rows: a different bird at a different per-lb price.

REUSE of bread-crumbs, live at 7 of 7: panko is a breadcrumb style sold on the same shelf in the same price class, not a form flip. The gram-per-cup difference is handled by weighing the line at 60 g/cup rather than by the id.

rulings.raw: ¼ Cup Whole Wheat Flour (or Gluten-free, for rolling the meatballs)
rulings.evidence: Genuine form flip, refused the bridge to flour (All-Purpose): whole wheat is its own bag at a higher per-lb price and a different gram weight per cup. New id proposed.
REUSE of eggs, live at 7 of 7, cheapest 0.99 at Fareway. One large egg is 50 g shelled; the estate's live '1 large egg (120 g)' defect is the error being avoided here.

new_commodity_proposals.evidence: Not already priced under another spelling: the only flour id in the estate is `flour`, whose vocabulary name is All-Purpose Flour, and no commodity, recipe-commodity or board row names a whole-grain wheat flour. It is a genuine form flip rather than a synonym: whole wheat is a separate bag at a higher per-lb price and a different gram weight per cup (about 120 g against 125 g for AP), so bridging it onto `flour` would publish both a wrong price and a wrong weight.
